LogList.fileType:
Log type. Valid values:
  • slowlog (slow log download list)
  • runlog (running log download list)
  • auditlog (audit list)
LogList.startTime: Start time, in the format "yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss"
LogList.endTime: End time, in the format "yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss"<li>If this parameter is not specified, logs within 24 hours from the start time are returned by default."<li>The maximum time span between the start time and end time is 7 days.
